Zulu: Izinhlelo Zokuxwayisa Kusenesikathi (ama-EWS) zingazisa odokotela uma iziguli zidinga usizo.
Hausa: Tsarin gargaɗi na farko (EWS) yana iya faɗakar da likitoci lokacin da marasa lafiya suke buƙatar kulawa.
Northern Sotho: Mananeo a temošo ya ka pela (di-EWS) a kgona go lemoša dingaka ge balwetši ba hloka šedi.
Amharic: ቅድመ ማስጠንቀቂያ ስርአቶች (ቅ.ማ.ስ) ታማሚዎች መቼ እንክብካቤ እንደሚያስፈልጋቸው ለዶክተሮች ያሳውቃሉ፡፡

Source: In this study, researchers looked at an EWS based on a chart with a simple numerical score related to vital signs, which helps doctors know when to check on the patient.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baatunuulira EWS nga basinziira ku kipande ekiriko obubonero bw’ennamba ezeekuusa ku bubonero obukulu, obuyamba abasawo okumanya ddi lwe balina okukebera ku mulwadde.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn olùwádìí ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò EWS nípa lílo àtẹ oní nọ́nbà tí ó jẹ mọ àyẹ̀wò àmì ilera, èyí tí ó máa ń ṣe ìràlọ́wọ́ fún àwọn dókítà láti mọ ìgbà tí ó yẹ kih wọ́n yẹ àwọn aláìsàn wọn wò.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babheke i-EWS esuselwa eshadini elinamaphuza alula ezinombolo ahlobene nezinkomba ezibalulekile, elisiza odokotela ukwazi ukuthi bahlole nini isiguli.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu bincike sun kalli EWS bisa ga ginshiƙi tare da ƙima mai sauƙi mai alaƙa da alamun mahimmanci, wanda ke taimaka wa likitoci su san lokacin da za su duba majiyyaci.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba lebeletše EWS ba hlokometše tšhate ye e nago le dintlha tša dinomoro tše bonolo tša go amana le maswao a bohlokwa, ao a thušago gore dingaka di tsebe gore ke neng fao ba ka lekolago balwetši.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች ዋነኛ ምልክቶች ላይ በቀላል የቁጥር ውጤት የተመሰረት ቻርት ያለው ቅ.ማ.ስን አይተዋል፤ ይህም ዶክተሮች መቼ ታማሚዎችን መመርመር እንዳለባቸው በማሳወቅ ያግዛቸዋል፡፡

Source: But, there are few statistical studies about how effective such EWSs actually are for pregnant women in developing countries.
Luganda: Wabula, waliwo okunoonyereza okw’ebibalo kutono okukwata ku nkola ya EWS zino yennyini ku bakazi abali embuto mu mawanga agakyakula.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n, àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ajẹmọ́ ìṣirò kọ̀ọ̀kan wà nípa bí àwọn EWS wọ̀nyí ṣe ṣiṣẹ́ sí fún àwọn obìnrin olóyùn ni àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tí ó ṣẹ̀ ń gbèrú.
Zulu: Kodwa, kunezingcwaningo ezimbalwa zesifundozinombolo ngokuthi ama-EWS asebenza kangakanani kahlekahle kwabesifazane abakhulelwe emazweni asathuthuka.
Hausa: Amma, akwai ƙananan nazarin ƙididdiga game da yadda irin waɗannan EWSs suke da tasiri ga mata masu juna biyu a ƙasashe masu tasowa.
Northern Sotho: Eupša, go na le dinyakišišo tše mmalwa tša dipalopalo tša mabapi le ka fao mananeo a di-EWS a šomago gabotse ka gona go basadi bao ba imilego ka dinageng tšeo di hlabologago.
Amharic: ነገርግን እንደዚህ አይነቶቹ ቅ.ማ.ስ በታዳጊ ሃገሮች ላሉ እርጉዝ ሴቶች ምን ያህል ውጤታማ እንደሆኑ የሚያሳዩ የስታትስቲክስ ጥናቶች አነስተኛ ናቸው፡፡

Source: Researchers wanted to see if the EWS works in a developing country like Nigeria.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baayagala okulaba oba nga EWS ekola mu ggwanga erikyakula nga Nigeria.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí fẹ́ láti rí bóya EWS ṣiṣẹ́ ní àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tí ó ṣẹ̀ ń gbèrú bíi Nigeria.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bebefuna ukubona ukuthi i-EWS iyasebenza yini ezweni elisathuthuka njenge-Nigeria.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun so su ga ko EWS yana aiki a cikin ƙasa mai tasowa kamar ƙasar Nijeriya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go tseba ge eba EWS e a šoma ka nageng yeo e hlabologago ya go swana le Nigeria.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደ ናይጄሪያ ባለ ታዳጊ ሃገር ቅ.ማ.ስ ይሰራ እንደሆነ ማየት ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

Source: They used statistics to get objective measurements of how well it works.
Luganda: Baakozesa ebibalo okufuna ebipimo ebituufu eby’engeri gy’ekolamu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n lo ọgbọ́n ìṣirò láti ṣe òdiwọn bí ó ti ṣiṣẹ́ dáradára sí.
Zulu: Basebenzise izinombolo ukuthola izikalo ezingachemile zokuthi isebenza kahle kanganani.
Hausa: Sun yi amfani da ƙididdiga don samun ma’auni na haƙiƙa na yadda yake aiki sosai.
Northern Sotho: Ba šomišitše dipalopalo go hwetša dikelo tša go se tšeye lehlakore mabapi le ka fao e šomago gabotse.
Amharic: ምን ያህል ውጤታማ እንደሆነ ተጨባጭ መረጃዎችን ለማግኘት ስታትስቲክስን ተጠቅመው ነበር፡፡

Source: They wanted to determine if the EWS was better for monitoring patients and reducing negative outcomes, like maternal mortality.
Luganda: Baayagala okumanya oba nga EWS yali ekola bulungiko mu kulondoola abalwadde n’okukendeeza ebivaamu ebibi, ng’okufa kwa bamaama.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí fẹ́ láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò bóyá EWS dára tó fún ṣíṣe àbojútó àwọn aláìsàn àti ṣíṣe àdínkù àbájáde òdì bí ikú ìyá ọlọ́mọ.
Zulu: Bebefuna ukuthola ukutho i-EWS ibingcono yini ekuqapheni iziguli nasekwehliseni imiphumela engemihle, njekufa komama.
Hausa: Suna so su ƙayyade idan EWS ya fi kyau don saka-idanu ga marasa lafiya da kuma rage sakamako mara kyau, kamar mace-macen masu haihuwa.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba nyaka go tseba ge eba EWS e be e le kaone go lekodišiša balwetši le go fokotša dipoelo tše di sego tša loka, tša go swana le go hlokofala ga baimana.
Amharic: ቅ.ማ.ስ ታሚዎችን ለመከታተል እና እንደ እናት ሞት ያሉ አሉታዊ ውጤቶችን ለማስወገድ የተሻለ እንደሆነ ማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

Source: The researchers studied 3 specialised hospitals in Northern Nigeria for 8 months.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza beetegereza amalwaliro ag’ekikugu 3 mu Nigeria ey’Ebukiikakkono okumala emyezi 8.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí ṣe ìwádìí àwọn ilé ìwòsàn aládáni 3 ní àríwá Nigeria fún oṣù 8.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bacwaninge izibhedlela ezi-3 ezikhethekile eNyakatho ne-Nigeria izinyanga eziyi-8.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi nazarin asibitoci na musamman guda 3 a Arewacin Nijeriya na tsawon watanni 8.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba nyakišišitše ka ga dipetlele tše 3 tše di kgethegilego ka Leboa la Nigeria mo dikgweding tše 8.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ለ8 ወራት በሰሜን ናይጄሪያ 3 ስፔሻላይዝ ያደረጉ ሆስፒታሎችን አጥንተው ነበር፡፡

Source: The doctors used the EWS on 1200 mothers and monitored another 1200 using other normal methods.
Luganda: Abasawo beeyambisa EWS ku bamaama 1200 ne balondoola abalala 1200 nga bakozesa enkola endala eza bulijjo.
Yoruba: Àwọn dókítà ṣe àmúlò EWS lóri 1200 àwọn iya ọlọ́mọ, wọ́n sì tún ṣe àbójútó 1200 mìíràn pèlú ilò ọ̀nà lásán.
Zulu: Odokotela basebenzise i-EWS komama abayi-1200 baphinde baqapha abanye abayi-1200 besebenzisa izindlela ezejwayelekile.
Hausa: Likitocin sun yi amfani da EWS a kan iyaye mata 1200 kuma sun sanya-ido a kan wasu 1200 ta hanyar amfani da wasu hanyoyin yau da kullum.
Northern Sotho: Dingaka di šomišitše EWS go bomma ba 1200 gomme tša lekodišiša ba bangwe ba 1200 ba šomiša mekgwa ye mengwe ye e tlwaelegilego.
Amharic: ዶክተሮቹ ቅ.ማ.ስን በ1200 እናቶች ላይ የተጠቀሙ ሲሆን ሌሎች 1200 እናቶችን ደግሞ መደበኛ ዘዴዎችን በመጠቀም ተከታትለዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers recorded how doctors used the EWS and the outcomes of the patients.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baawandiika engeri abasawo gye baakozesaamu EWS n’ebyatuuka ku balwadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí ṣe àgbàsílẹ̀ bí àwọn dohkítà ti ṣe lo EWS àti àbájáde rẹ̀ lórí àwọn aláìsàn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqophe ukuthi odokotela bayisbenzisa kanjani –EWS nemiphumela yeziguli.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun rubuta yadda likitoci suka yi amfani da EWS da kuma sakamakon marasa lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba gatišitše ka fao dingaka di bego di šomiša EWS le dipoelo tša balwetši.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ዶክተሮች እንዴት ቅ.ማ.ስን እንደተጠቀሙ እና የታማሚዎችን ውጤቶች ሪኮርድ አድርገዋል፡፡

Source: They also interviewed the doctors to see if they felt the EWS was useful.
Luganda: Era baabuuza abasawo okulaba oba nga baali bawulira nti EWS ya mugaso.
Yoruba: Bákan náà ni wọn fi ọ̀rọ̀ wá àwọn dókítà lẹ́nuwọ̀ láti rí bóyá wọ́n gbà pé EWS wúlò.
Zulu: Baphinde bahlola izimvo zodokotela ukubona ukuthi babona ngathi i-EWS iyasebenza yini.
Hausa: Haka nan sun kuma yi hira da likitocin don ganin ko suna jin EWS yana da amfani.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba botšiša dingaka dipotšišo go tseba ge eba ba bone gore EWS e bile mohola.
Amharic: ቅ.ማ.ስ ጠቃሚ ነው ብለው ያስቡ እንደሆነ ለማወቅ ለዶክተሮቹ ቃለ መጠይቅ አድርገው ነበር፡፡

Source: While the EWS did not seem to reduce maternal mortality or other negative outcomes, the doctors monitored patients more frequently, and caesarean sections decreased.
Luganda: Newankubadde nga EWS teyafaanana kukendeeza kufa kwa bamaama oba ebivaamu ebirala ebibi, abasawo baalondoola abalwadde emirundi mingiko, era okulongoosa bamaama kwakendeera.
Yoruba: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò dàbí pé EWS ní ipa kankan lórí àdínkù ikú àwọn ìyá ọlọ́mọ tabí àwọn àbájáde òdì mìíràn, àwọn dókítà ṣe àbojútó àwọn aláìsàn lóòrèkóòre bẹ́ẹ̀ sì níiṣẹ́ abẹ dínkù.
Zulu: Noma i-EWS ibibukeka ingehlisi ukufa komama noma eminye imiphumela engemihle, odokotela baqaphe iziguli ngouvame okuthe xaxa, kanti nokuteta ngosikwa kwehla.
Hausa: Duk da yake EWS ba zai rage yawan mace-macen mata masu juna biyu ko wasu sakamako mara kyau ba, likitoci sun sa-ido a kan marasa lafiya akai-akai, da kuma haihuwa ta hanyar tiyata sun ragu.
Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore EWS ga se ya bonala e fokotša mahu a baimana goba dipoelo tše dingwe tše di sego tša loka, dingaka di lekotše balwetši kgafetšakgafetša kudu, gomme go belega ka diophareišene go ile gwa fokotšega.
Amharic: ቅ.ማ.ስ የእናቶችን ሞት ወይም ሌሎች አሉታዊ ውጤቶችን የቀነሰ ባይመስልም ዶክተሮች ታካሚዎችን እየደጋገሙ ተከታትለዋቸዋል፣ የቀዶ ማዋለድም ቀንሶ ነበር፡፡

Source: However, the EWS was only used correctly about half of the time.
Luganda: Wabula, EWS yakozesebwa mu butuufu ekitundu nga kimu kyakubiri eky’emirundi gyonna.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n ṣá, bí àbọ̀ ìgbà tí wọ́n ń ṣe àmùlò EWS nìkan ni ó jẹ́ wípẹ́ wọn maa ń lò ó ní ọ̀nà tí ó tọ́.
Zulu: Nokho, i-EWS isetshenziswe ngendlela uhhafu wesikhathi.
Hausa: Ko ta yaya, an yi amfani da EWS daidai kusan rabin lokacin.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, EWS e šomišitšwe fela gabotse mo tekanong ya seripagre sa nako yeo.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ቅ.ማ.ስ በትክክሉ ጥቅም ላይ የዋለው ግማሹን ጊዜ ብቻ ነው፡፡

Source: Despite this, the interviews showed that the EWS indeed helped the doctors in Nigeria.
Luganda: Newankubadde guli gutyo, ebibuuzo byalaga nti EWS mu butuufu zaayamba abasawo mu Nigeria.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀, àwọn ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò fihàn pé EWS ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́ púpọ̀ fún àwọn dókítà ní tòótọ́.
Zulu: Ngale kwalokhu, izinhlolovo zikhombise ukuthi i-EWS ngempela ibasizile odokotela e-Nigeria.
Hausa: Duk da haka, tambayoyin sun nuna cewa EWS ya taimaka wa likitocin a Nijeriya.
Northern Sotho: Ka ntle le se, dipotšišo tšeo di bego di botšišwa dingaka di laeditše gore EWS e tloga e thušitše dingaka ka Nigeria.
Amharic: ይህ እንዳለ ሆኖ፣ ቅ.ማ.ስ በእርግጥም የናይጄሪያን ዶክተሮች እንደጠቀመ ቃለ መጠይቁ ያሳያል፡፡

Source: For example, they could evaluate patients more quickly because it was easier to use.
Luganda: Okugeza, baasobola okwekenneenya abalwadde mu budde obutonoko kubanga kyali kyangu okukozesa.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, wọ́n le ṣe ìgbéléwọ̀n àwọn aláìsàn kíákía nítorí ó rọrùn láti lò.
Zulu: Isibonelo, Bebengakwazi ukuhlola iziguli ngokushesha okuthe xaxa ngoba bekuthe ukuba lula ukuyisebenzisa.
Hausa: Misali, za su iya ƙimanta marasa lafiya da sauri saboda yana da sauƙin amfani.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, ba ka kgona go hlahloba balwetši ka pela kudu ka ge e be e le bonolo go šomišwa.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ ለመጠቀም ቀላል ስለሆነ ታማሚዎችን በተሻለ ፍጥነት መገምገም ችለው ነበር፡፡

Source: They also said that the EWS gave accurate predictions of the attention a patient needed.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti EWS yakola okuteebereza okutuukiridde okw’okufiibwako omulwadde kwe yali yeetaaga.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ wí pé EWS yìí fún àwọn ni àfojúsùn pàtó nípa ìtọjú pàtàkì tí àwọn aláìsàn wọn nilò.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi i-EWS ibanike iziqagulo ezinembayo yokunakwa isiguli ebesikudinga.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce EWS ya bayar da ingantattun hasashen kulawar da majiyyaci yake buƙata.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gape gore EWS e file dikakanyo tše di nepagetšego mabapi le šedi yeo molwetši a e hlokago.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ አንድ ታካሚ የሚያስፈልገውን የእንክብካቤ መጠንም ቅ.ማ.ስ በትክክሉ እንደተነበየ ገልጸዋል፡፡

Source: This study shows that EWSs designed for one place can also be beneficial to others.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kulaga nti EWS ezaakolebwa olw’ekifo ekimu era zisobola okuganyula abalala.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwadìí yìí fihàn pé àwọn EWS tí wọn gbékalẹ̀ fún agbègbè kan le è wúlò fún agbègbè mìíràn.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi i-EWS ehlelelwe indawo ethile ingasebenza nakwezinye izindawo.

Source: They also gave essential advice to use EWSs effectively.
